name: common
description: Shared mindset skills required by the alegomes topology plugins. Ships mental-model, active-listener, zero-micromanagement, default-yes (decida em vez de perguntar: acao reversivel ou que so registra e executada e prestada conta no relatorio; pergunta so para o irreversivel e sempre em lote nas pontas da sessao, nunca pingada no meio — inclui a disciplina de fio: proposta em aberto reaparece ate ser resolvida e assunto lateral fica estacionado ate o fechamento), conversational-response, till-done, autonomous-mode, green-or-revert, and acceptance-completeness. Agents: completion-auditor (independent last-mile acceptance gate), ui-proof-reviewer (independent proof gate for the UI/extension surface — pinned Playwright flows from .claude/ui-proof.yaml, fresh backend asserts, green→red→green perturbation). Commands: /session (sessao com proposito declarado: preflight em lote, TODAS as perguntas na largada — inclusive as que a rotina so faria no meio ou no fim —, execucao sem interrupcao, UM relatorio final com o que foi decidido sozinho e o que ficou estacionado, e o wrap-up como ultimo passo), /doctor (agora com --fix: aplica em lote as correcoes MECANICAS e REVERSIVEIS — reinstalar plugins em drift, arquivar handoff vencido sem apagar, limpar registro de worktree cujo diretorio sumiu — e re-diagnostica ate estabilizar, em vez de propor uma correcao por vez; o que envolve escolha sai no bloco 'Precisa de voce'. Valida a instalação do harness — plugins, hooks, baseline, worktrees, handoffs, plus the operational-update checks: an install that died halfway leaves status=in_progress in ~/.claude/ops/last-install.json and is reported as a FAILURE rather than silence, live-vs-repo drift carries the age of the last install, and a recent --rollback is called out because the live cache is then the one BEFORE the install you attempted), /metrics (telemetria do próprio harness: sessões, builds, bloqueios de gate, vereditos de prova, e o atrito das pontas da sessão — turnos gastos ANTES do primeiro comando de rotina e DEPOIS do último ate o wrap-up, medidos pelo hook session-log, que grava so o NOME do comando, nunca o texto do prompt — ledger em ~/.claude/cepa-telemetry alimentado pelos hooks via _telemetry.py), /autonomous-start, /autonomous-resume, /debrief, /recap, /handoff (save a rich session handoff for seamless resume), /next (answers "what do I do next?" at any moment from the single-track execution plan — names ONE step with the `why` recorded at prioritisation, never a menu, and separates pending human action from the next item; a tracker is optional: with board-flow.yaml it reconciles against the live board, without one it answers from the plan and says the statuses are self-reported. Read-only unless --sync), /branch, /return, and the per-session worktree lifecycle (/worktree-start, /worktree-merge, /worktree-list, /worktree-discard, /worktree-name, /worktree-label — get/set a durable free-text purpose stored as the branch description) for parallel `claude` windows on one repo, plus /wrap-up — the one-shot session-shutdown chain (commit → handoff → merge into the integration branch → push → prune, behind a single confirmation; --discard for dead ends) that reuses worktree-merge's green-gate / single-owner / conflict-stop guards. Ships plan-schema.yaml — the CANONICAL annotated plan.yaml (schema v2), shared by two sibling consumers with no dependency between them: maestro's `mode: parallel-waves` (waves of slices in worktrees) and board-flow's `mode: single-track` (one item at a time across sessions, carrying the execution order, the `why` behind each position, and the `human_pending` left for the human after a card closes). v2 makes `mode` explicit and required — the number is what lets a wave-only consumer refuse a document it cannot read instead of reading a missing `waves` as an empty plan. v1 (waves only, no `mode`) is still accepted by every consumer, so plans already on disk need no migration; `mode: single-track` in a v1 plan is refused with an instruction to raise the version. Bin: cepa-dor — invocable Definition-of-Ready check for plan.yaml slices (schema v1 and v2), which refuses a single-track plan by pointing at /board-flow:triage and /common:next instead of failing downstream with "no pending wave": disjoint surfaces expanded at the fork point, enforcement-zone veto, resolved human gates, executable acceptance (mandatory in no-build repos), green baseline, >=4-demand floor, and the BDD-or-substrate form check (an acceptance that only names private implementation steps is NOT-READY unless the slice declares acceptance_form: substrate); first client is maestro's intake gate, board-flow triage/drain are foreseen consumers. Launcher: bin/cepa (renamed from bin/ccw on 2026-07-30; the old name is gone, not aliased) — drop-in for `claude` that auto-isolates a session into its own git worktree only when another live session already occupies the tree; `cepa -s <name>` forces/resumes a named worktree, and `cepa -s` with no name opens an interactive picker (fzf, else a numbered menu) of recent session/* worktrees — terminal-agnostic, unlike Tab completion which Warp's own engine ignores. Completions: completions/_cepa — zsh tab-completion for `cepa -s <slice>`, offering existing session/* worktrees newest-first, each captioned with its label (works in standard terminals; Warp ignores zsh completions, so use the `cepa -s` picker there). Hooks: autonomous-checkpoint (PostToolUse on Task), session-log (UserPromptSubmit), session-subject (UserPromptSubmit — lexical subject-shift detection + wrap-up/handoff nudge; points at /common:wrap-up when the session is landable, else /common:handoff), session-activity (PostToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit — records touched dirs), session-registry (SessionStart/SessionEnd — live-session registry, overlap warning, worktree auto-clean + unmerged reminder, WIP-autosave, transparent handoff resume, deferred worktree prune-on-exit so /wrap-up never deletes its own live cwd, and the .claude/ artifact rescue: before ANY worktree removal (the automatic paths in-process; /worktree-merge and /worktree-discard call `python3 _wtlib.py rescue <worktree>` first — the raw-remove gap that ate a 47-item triage plan on 2026-08-16) the gitignored artifacts under .claude/ (plans, proof, acceptance) are copied to .claude/rescued/<branch>/ in the main worktree and announced at the next SessionStart. An ignored file is invisible to every other guard — `git status --porcelain` omits it, so is_dirty() reads clean and the WIP-autosave never fires, and `git worktree remove` deletes it returning 0 even WITHOUT --force; that is how a WEGO execution plan of 10 prioritized follow-ups was lost on 2026-08-10), session-checkpoint (Stop — continuous mechanical handoff skeleton at .claude/handoffs/<branch>.md, crash-proof), mark-build-stale + capture-build-result + gate-advance (the green-or-revert state machine; worktree-aware — a build or edit in an out-of-root proof worktree records/skips THERE, never poisoning the main baseline with a deliberate perturbation RED), enforcement-guard (PreToolUse Bash + Edit/Write/MultiEdit — blocks subagents from writing the plugin/hook/settings enforcement surface), maven-reactor-guard (PreToolUse Bash — blocks `mvn`/`mvnw` with `-pl`/`--projects` but no `-am` when the cwd is a multi-module reactor: without `-am` Maven resolves sibling modules from the possibly-stale `~/.m2` instead of recompiling, producing a deterministic-but-FALSE red that reads as a functional bug; `-amd` does not count, single-module repos are never gated, a quoted `mvn` inside echo/grep is not an invocation, and `stale-ok` in the command is the explicit escape hatch for a freshly-installed reactor — WEGO-1949, where documenting it twice failed to stop the recurrence), ui-proof-verdict-guard (PreToolUse Write — blocks a .claude/proof/ui-*.yaml declaring verdict: proven when any flow is not pass or a perturbation survived/assumed), lead-no-worktree (PreToolUse on Task — blocks worktree-isolated leads), acceptance-gate (PreToolUse on transitionJiraIssue AND jira_transition_issue — blocks the FORWARD move to In-Review/Done while the acceptance audit is incomplete, and only that: the target status is resolved through `defaults.transition_ids` in board-flow.yaml, so sending the card BACK is never blocked — it is what an incomplete audit should cause. Unresolvable target, missing map or broken config fails CLOSED. Until 2026-08-01 the gate was direction-blind (it trapped WEGO-1782 in Review) and matched only the cloud dialect, so it had zero teeth on mcp-atlassian), summary-nulls-gate (PreToolUse on addCommentToJiraIssue/jira_add_comment — blocks an Implementation Summary comment missing the explicit-null fields: New debt introduced, Scope captured outside the card, Release needed, Human validation route; when the declared debt is anything other than none/unknown it additionally requires a Revisit trigger, so debt that outlives the card carries the condition that brings it back), handoff-seeds-gate (PreToolUse Edit/Write/MultiEdit on docs/discovery/*/handoff.md — blocks a delivery brief missing labeled Validation seeds / Carry-forward notes; an explicit `none` is a valid answer, silence is not. Seeds thought up AFTER the build describe what got built, and discovery's implementation-relevant findings are otherwise re-discovered the expensive way), merge-truth-gate (PreToolUse on both transition tools — when a transition targets `done`, git is the witness: commits carrying the key reachable from the integration branch ALLOW the close and the sha is handed back for the closing comment; commits that exist only off-branch BLOCK it, which is the six-card 'pendente de merge' lie the board kept telling; no commit at all allows freely, since a decision/spike card has nothing to reconcile. Fails OPEN — it asserts a positive fact about git rather than withholding a privilege), bounce-reason-gate (PreToolUse on the same comment tools — blocks a bounce-back comment, i.e. one whose heading announces UNPROVEN / returning for rework / devolução, that carries no labeled Reason:/Motivo: with text; the next session must not have to re-derive WHY from the diff). Helpers: _wtlib.py + session-launch.py + session-worktrees.py (worktree engine), _handoff.py (handoff file format + zone-preserving IO), expertise-append.py (flock-serialized append+prune for the shared mental-model.yaml files).
